webhooks.summary: Stripe exposes a webhook endpoint management API under /v1/webhook_endpoints that lets you register, list, retrieve, update, and delete outbound webhook endpoints. Endpoints require a url and an enabled_events list, and optionally a connect flag to receive events from all connected accounts. The OpenAPI content provided does not enumerate specific event names, signature headers, or verification schemes.

managementEndpoints.description: Create a webhook endpoint; requires url and enabled_events, optional connect
Retrieve a webhook endpoint by ID
Update url, enabled_events, or status of a webhook endpoint

signature.detail: The supplied OpenAPI content does not specify a signature header or verification scheme.

setupSteps.title: Obtain the registry inbound hook URL
setupSteps.detail: In the package registry workspace, copy the stable inbound hook URL that will receive Stripe events.

setupSteps.title: Decide account vs Connect scope
setupSteps.detail: Choose whether to receive account events only (connect=false or omitted) or events from all connected accounts (connect=true).

setupSteps.title: Select event types for enabled_events
setupSteps.detail: Prepare the list of enabled_events to subscribe to; the provided OpenAPI does not enumerate the available event names, so consult Stripe's event reference for the exact identifiers.

setupSteps.title: Create the webhook endpoint via the Stripe API
setupSteps.detail: POST /v1/webhook_endpoints with body fields url=<registry inbound hook URL>, enabled_events=[...], and optionally connect=true|false. Store the returned endpoint ID and signing secret for later verification.

setupSteps.title: Confirm registration
setupSteps.detail: GET /v1/webhook_endpoints (or GET /v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}) to verify the endpoint is active and points at the registry hook URL. The Stripe dashboard webhooks area at https://dashboard.stripe.com/account/webhooks can also be used to register the hook URL instead of the API.
